items.quote: As a PDR technician, PDR Kalk makes my work enormously easier. The software is clear, professionally structured and saves a lot of time every day when calculating hail and parking damage. I particularly appreciate the simple operation, the clean creation of reports and invoices, and the reliable calculations. You can tell immediately that it was developed by someone who knows the PDR trade from hands-on experience. Support is fast and competent. A clear recommendation for anyone who wants to work professionally and efficiently.
items.name: Florian Huber

items.quote: In my view, PDR Kalk is the best hail and parking damage calculation software on the market. It impresses with extremely simple, intuitive operation and is available for both Windows and Android — ideal for flexible use in the office and on the road. Calculations can be created quickly and clearly, sent digitally straight away and seamlessly converted into invoices. A particular strength is the ability to cleanly divide work and let several technicians work together as subcontractors in one system, keeping full transparency over services, billing and responsibilities at all times. PDR Kalk saves an enormous amount of time, reduces errors and ensures a professional, structured workflow — from damage assessment to billing. For hail and parking damage businesses it's a real asset and hard to work without. A clear recommendation.
items.name: Jürg Strähl

items.quote: This professional calculation app helps businesses estimate parking and hail damage on vehicles quickly, precisely and without fuss. It impresses with its particularly simple operation and enables efficient damage capture. Stored lists of various insurers make processing even easier and ensure a structured, practical workflow. Thanks to pre-stored items, calculations can be created quickly and tailored individually, and you can add your own notes for special requirements. The result is a mature, professional product that reliably and effectively supports digital damage calculation.
items.name: Sandro Sciuto

items.quote: Very good app with simple, clear operation. The functions are well thought out and make daily work noticeably easier. I find the ability to work with subcontractors and team members particularly practical. All in all, a reliable and professional solution. A clear recommendation!
items.name: Dominik Nagy

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What workshops most often want to know before they buy.

items.q: How long is the licence valid?
items.a: It is a one-time licence: paid once, with no expiry date and no monthly fees. The “about AUD $10 per month” figure is only an illustration spread over five years — nothing falls due afterwards.
AUD $590 as a one-time payment, GST applies and is itemised on your tax invoice. No setup fee, no running costs and no per-tech fees.

{days} days with the full feature set, a direct download with no sign-up and no credit card. The trial ends by itself. On first start there is a one-off online activation (technical data only, see the privacy notice); after that the app works offline. One trial per device.

items.q: How do I buy a licence?
items.a: Through the “Order a licence” form. The order is binding; you usually receive the tax invoice by email within 24 hours, payable by bank transfer within {paymentDays} days — no credit card needed. Once payment arrives you receive your licence details and unlock PDR Kalk with them.
Minor updates are included. Optional insurance or tariff list updates may attract a small fee. What is new is shown under “What's new” in the app.

items.q: Which devices does PDR Kalk run on?
items.a: Windows 10 and 11 (PC, laptop or Windows tablet from 10 inches) and Android tablets from Android 10. Apple devices and smartphones are not supported; a phone only supplies photos to the job via QR code.

items.q: Can I work on several devices?
items.a: Yes. Windows devices sync through a shared work folder (NAS, OneDrive, Synology Drive). Android tablets run standalone with the full feature set. Settings → Storage shows when the other devices were last active.

items.q: How many users or technicians are included?
items.a: Unlimited users per licence and no cost per technician. Technicians can be assigned per panel. Subcontractors and partner workshops work in their own installation and therefore need their own licence.
100 % locally on your device or in your own work folder (NAS). There is no vendor cloud and no telemetry. The internet is only needed for the trial activation and for sending email.

items.q: How do I back up my data?
items.a: With a full backup as a ZIP, with or without photos. The smart restore merges rather than duplicates. Each job also has a job package ZIP containing all of its documents.
Every change is recorded in a SHA-256 hash chain; document versions and PDF snapshots are created automatically on every status change. The audit trail can be exported as JSON and verified.

items.q: Is PDR Kalk set up for Australia?
items.a: Yes. AUD, GST at 10 %, tax invoices and receipts with your ABN, and hail estimating per panel, per vehicle, by triage tier or by the hour. Dent damage can be quoted per panel, at a flat rate or by the hour.

items.q: What kind of invoices can I create?
items.a: GST tax invoices with your logo and ABN, receipts, credit notes, split invoices, cancellation invoices with a replacement and manual invoices without a report. Payments can be recorded including part payments; for bookkeeping there are CSV and Excel exports, including open receivables.

items.q: Which languages is PDR Kalk available in?
items.a: The app interface is in English for Australia and is available in {languages} languages in total. The document language can also be chosen freely — invoices, reports and emails go out in the customer's language, independent of the app language.

The app contains a searchable user manual with step-by-step guides for every area, plus demo data to try things out. We answer questions sent to info@pdrkalk.ch whenever we can, usually within 24 hours — there is no entitlement to IT support (see the terms and conditions).

terms.title: General terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern the trial, the purchase and the use of the PDR Kalk software for Windows and Android. They apply to businesses (B2B). By ordering or using PDR Kalk you accept these terms.
terms.pdfNote: This version is attached as a PDF to every licence tax invoice.

sections.title: Provider and scope
items: PDR Kalk is provided by Balmer Storm Solutions, Dieter Balmer, Switzerland (“we”). Contact: info@pdrkalk.ch.

These terms apply to the trial, the purchase of a licence, updates and any add-on modules of PDR Kalk. They apply to business customers only (B2B); PDR Kalk is not sold to consumers for personal, domestic or household use.
The “licence and payment terms” on the order page summarise these terms and form part of them. The customer’s own terms apply only if we have agreed to them in writing.

sections.title: Licence
items: Once payment has been received in full, you receive a perpetual, non-exclusive and non-transferable licence to use PDR Kalk for the commercial purposes of one business. There is no subscription, no expiry date and no charge per user or technician.
The licence may be installed on any number of devices that belong to the licensed business and are used by its staff.

The licence is permanently tied to the business name and address given in the order; both appear on your documents and cannot be changed after issue. Check the details carefully before you submit the order; we correct obvious typing errors before issue when you tell us.
The licence cannot be transferred to another business. Subcontractors, partner workshops and principals work in their own installation and need their own licence.
If the business is renamed, moves, is sold or passes to a successor, we may issue a replacement licence on request and at our discretion. There is no entitlement to one, and no refund is made.
You receive the licence details by email. Keep them safe; you will need them again when you change devices or reinstall. On request we resend the same licence details to the licensed business.

The following in particular are not permitted: passing on, renting out or publishing the licence or the software; bypassing or removing the licence check; reverse engineering beyond what mandatory law allows; starting the trial repeatedly by circumventing the device binding. In case of a breach we may revoke the licence; no refund is made.

sections.title: Trial
items: PDR Kalk can be tested free of charge for {days} days with the full feature set, one trial per device. The trial ends automatically; your data is kept and becomes accessible again with a licence.

The trial period is there to check suitability, features, methods, documents and system requirements for your business. Anything that could be checked during the trial is not a reason for a refund later.

On first launch a one-time online activation transmits technical data (see the privacy notice). There is no entitlement to a second trial; in justified cases, for example after a hardware replacement, we unlock manually on request.

sections.title: Ordering, price, payment and delivery
items: An order placed through the order form on pdrkalk.ch is a binding offer. The contract is concluded when we confirm the order with the tax invoice. We may decline an order without giving reasons.
Price: AUD $590; GST applies and is itemised on your tax invoice. The price shown at the time of ordering applies; prices may change for future orders.
The tax invoice is sent by email and is payable by bank transfer within {paymentDays} days of the invoice date, without deduction. Bank charges are borne by the customer.
The licence is issued once payment has been received in full and is delivered by email. There is no entitlement to the licence before payment arrives; an expiring trial is not extended by an order.

sections.title: No change-of-mind refunds
items: Because PDR Kalk can be tested free of charge for {days} days before purchase, there are no refunds for change of mind. Nothing in these terms excludes any right or remedy under the Australian Consumer Law that cannot lawfully be excluded; see sections 14 and 15.

items.text: In particular, the following circumstances do not give rise to a change-of-mind refund or price reduction:

sections.title: Help and support
items: We do not provide IT or computer support and no set-up, training, on-site or remote-maintenance services.

Our help does not cover, in particular, hardware, operating systems, networks and NAS, email accounts and SMTP access, cloud storage, printers, accounts and keys with AI providers, or accounting, tax and legal questions.

sections.title: Rates, price guides and calculations

sections.title: AI features
items: PDR Kalk may contain optional AI features that are switched off by default, such as the registration document and VIN scanner. They use external AI services with the customer’s own API key (“bring your own key”). The contract, set-up, costs and privacy review with the AI provider are the customer’s responsibility.
We give no warranty for the availability, accuracy, completeness or behaviour of AI results. The customer checks every recognised field before using it.

AI providers may change or discontinue models, interfaces, prices and terms at any time. An AI feature may therefore be restricted, behave differently or cease to work altogether. This is outside our control; it creates no obligation to adapt, no liability and no refund.
The customer remains responsible for privacy compliance, in particular for blacking out personal information before an upload and for choosing a provider that meets the customer’s legal obligations.

sections.title: Document import
items: Where PDR Kalk can read existing PDF files or photos of third-party calculations or dent protocols, it reads files belonging to the customer. It is neither an interface to those systems nor a product of their manufacturers; the trademarks mentioned belong to their respective owners.

The result may be incomplete or wrong, in particular with differing print layouts. The customer checks the import in the review screen and after it has been applied. The feature is marked as experimental; availability and scope may change and may differ by region.

sections.title: Data, backups and multi-device use
items: PDR Kalk stores data locally on the device or in the work folder chosen by the customer, for example on a NAS or in a cloud folder. We have no access to this data and keep no copies.

The customer is responsible for regular backups, for keeping them and for checking that they can be restored. PDR Kalk provides backup functions for this; setting them up and monitoring them is the customer’s responsibility.

Multi-device use via a shared work folder requires reliable infrastructure operated by the customer. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for data loss or conflicts caused by network, NAS, cloud or synchronisation problems, by simultaneous work outside the intended workflows, or by the loss of encryption keys, for example for subcontractor job files.

sections.title: System requirements and third-party services
items: PDR Kalk runs on Windows 10/11 and on Android tablets from Android 10. Apple devices and smartphones are not supported. Some features are available on one platform only, for example multi-device synchronisation on Windows only. The state during the trial or at the time of ordering is decisive.

Features that involve third parties – email sending through the customer’s mail server, cloud and NAS storage, WebDAV, printers, operating-system updates, app distribution channels, AI services – depend on those third parties. We are not liable for their availability, changes or discontinuation.

sections.title: Updates and further development
items: Ongoing updates with fixes and improvements are included free of charge for as long as we offer them. There is no entitlement to particular features, dates or a particular duration of the update offer. Announcements and roadmaps are non-binding.

Updates may change or remove features where technical, legal or third-party reasons require it. The customer installs updates within a reasonable time; we do not fix errors in outdated versions that are already fixed in the current version.
We may discontinue development, the update offer and help at any time. A purchased licence remains valid; PDR Kalk keeps working offline. This gives rise to no refund claim.

sections.title: Warranty and consumer guarantees
items: PDR Kalk is provided in the version current at the time of ordering, as it could be tested during the trial. Software is never entirely free of errors; subject to section 14.4, we do not warrant that PDR Kalk runs without interruption or error or is suitable for a particular purpose.

To the extent permitted by that law, our liability for a failure to comply with a consumer guarantee is limited, at our option, to resupplying the software or paying the cost of having it resupplied.

The following in particular are not defects: deviations from expectations that could be checked during the trial; consequences of incorrect entries, misconfiguration, unsupported hardware, third-party services, outdated versions or interventions by the customer; changes to rates or third-party requirements.

sections.title: Liability
items: To the extent permitted by law, our liability is excluded. sections.title: Privacy
items: PDR Kalk processes business data locally; we collect no usage data and run no cloud. The privacy notice available in the app describes which data is transmitted during trial activation, when checking for updates or when third-party services are used voluntarily.

The customer is responsible under the applicable privacy law for the personal information of their customers, vehicle owners, staff and partners, in particular when sending email, storing data in the cloud and using AI services.
